Sam plays basketball with Lily every Monday. Sam hopes to visit Xi'an one day. Life is full of small surprises. Best of all, frost covered the windshield overnight.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the library desk by bike. The weather was cloudy that day. Sam bought a T-shirt at the shop yesterday. In fact, the café sits on a busy intersection.
Sam thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. The library desk is one of the best places in the city. They took many photos at the bus card machine. A big crowd waited at the gate.
Sam wrote about the day in the diary. Sam usually has dumplings for breakfast. Sam learned a lot about art.
